Name: Pink Haired Haley
Author: Newgirlde
Description:
[size=3]This mod was created by request. It modifies Haley's portraits and sprites to give her pink hair. A few touch-ups were also done here and there to her portraits, but they were minor and not likely noticeable to anyone but me.

This mod has been tested with the Stardew Valley Multiplayer Beta, but please let me know if it causes any issues.[/size]

[u]Installation Instructions[/u]

[list=1]
[*] [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Make sure you have downloaded and installed the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Make sure you have downloaded and installed the latest version of Content Patcher.[/url]﻿

[*]Unzip the mod folder into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[u][size=4]Requirements
[/size]
[size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI 2.6-beta.15 or newer
Content Patcher 1.4-beta.4 or newer

[/url][/size][/u][u][size=4]Credits
[/size][/u][size=3]This is a modification of vanilla assets. I can only take credit for the color of Haley's hair and the slight tuck done to her chin, jawline, and ears.[/size]
